markers.impact: Altered satiety signaling / increased appetite susceptibility
markers.interpretation: FTO rs9939609 is the most robust common obesity-risk locus. The A allele affects FTO expression, altering hypothalamus satiety signaling and increasing baseline appetite and food intake. Strongly modifiable by exercise and protein intake.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: The risk effect is completely abolished in individuals with high physical activity or high-protein diet regimes.

sources.name: FTO gene variants and obesity association
sources.notes: Large-scale genome-wide association study identifying FTO as a primary locus.

markers.interpretation: PPARG is a master regulator of fat cell development and insulin sensitivity. The G allele (Ala) is associated with improved insulin sensitivity and lower type 2 diabetes risk compared to the Pro/Pro genotype. A robust metabolic marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Though protective, metabolic health is ultimately determined by caloric balance, fiber intake, and skeletal muscle insulin action.

sources.name: PPARG Pro12Ala and Type 2 Diabetes Risk Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Confirms a highly replicated, modest protective effect of the Ala allele against type 2 diabetes.

markers.interpretation: KCNQ1 regulates potassium channels in pancreatic beta cells. The rs2237897 A allele is a robust marker associated with impaired insulin secretion following glucose loads, carrying a modest risk signal for type 2 diabetes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common risk SNP; actual insulin secretion and glucose disposal are highly responsive to cardiovascular fitness and carbohydrate load.

sources.name: KCNQ1 variants and Type 2 Diabetes susceptibility in East Asian populations
sources.notes: Seminal study identifying KCNQ1 as a key diabetes locus in Asian and European cohorts.

markers.impact: Impaired GLP-1 secretion / elevated type 2 diabetes risk
markers.interpretation: TCF7L2 rs7903146 is the most significant common genetic risk locus for Type 2 Diabetes. The T allele is linked to reduced insulin secretion and impaired beta-cell response to GLP-1. Modifiable via low-glycemic index diets and exercise.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common risk SNP; dietary composition and physical training mitigate the risk completely.

sources.name: TCF7L2 polymorphism and T2D risk
sources.notes: Replicated association of TCF7L2 with beta-cell function impairment.

markers.impact: Impaired zinc transport / reduced beta-cell insulin crystallization
markers.interpretation: SLC30A8 is a zinc transporter in pancreatic beta cells. The C allele (Arg325) affects insulin storage and secretion kinetics, slightly increasing diabetes risk.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Dietary zinc status can influence the manifestation of this transporter phenotype.

sources.name: SLC30A8 Arg325 variant and diabetes risk
sources.notes: Identifies SLC30A8 as a highly replicated beta-cell GWAS locus.

markers.interpretation: KCNJ11 rs5219 (E23K variant, T allele) keeps the pancreatic beta-cell potassium channel open longer, decreasing insulin secretion in response to glucose.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: ATP-sensitive potassium channels are drug targets for sulfonylureas; clinical PGx requires full panel curation.

sources.name: KCNJ11 Glu23Lys and diabetes susceptibility
sources.notes: Meta-analysis confirming modest risk elevation of E23K.

markers.impact: Altered glucokinase activity / triglyceride-glucose balance shift
markers.interpretation: GCKR regulates glucokinase in the liver. The T allele is associated with lower fasting glucose but higher fasting triglycerides, illustrating a metabolic lipid-glucose partition tradeoff.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Substrate partitioning is highly modified by fructose/alcohol intake and cardiovascular training.

sources.name: GCKR and lipid-glucose phenotypes
sources.notes: GWAS showing GCKR's dual effects on glucose and plasma lipids.

markers.impact: Reduced APOA5 expression / elevated fasting triglycerides
markers.interpretation: APOA5 rs662799 C allele is strongly associated with elevated serum triglycerides due to reduced clearing of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Fasting triglycerides are highly responsive to dietary refined carbohydrate levels and omega-3 intake.

sources.name: APOA5 -1131T>C and hypertriglyceridemia
sources.notes: Large cohort study mapping APOA5 variants to triglyceride clearance.

markers.impact: Altered Lipoprotein Lipase activity / triglyceride clearance
markers.interpretation: LPL rs328 G-allele (Ser44Ter) causes premature truncation, resulting in increased LPL activity, leading to lower triglycerides and higher HDL.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Protective variant; clearance rates are also regulated by insulin levels (metabolic health).

sources.name: LPL Ser447Ter meta-analysis
sources.notes: Large scale consensus mapping of LPL protective variations.

markers.impact: Altered cholesteryl ester transfer protein activity
markers.interpretation: The A (TaqIB B2) allele of rs708272 is linked to decreased CETP expression, which increases protective HDL cholesterol levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: High HDL levels do not always translate to cardiac protection if particles are dysfunctional.

sources.name: CETP TaqIB and coronary heart disease risk
sources.notes: Large cohort study confirming increased HDL in B2 carriers.

markers.interpretation: LPA rs10455872 is a robust promoter-associated SNP driving elevated levels of Lipoprotein(a). High Lp(a) levels are an independent, highly genetically determined risk factor for cardiovascular disease.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Microarray analysis only captures specific alleles; direct measurement of serum Lp(a) is required to determine absolute risk.

sources.name: LPA variants and coronary disease risk
sources.notes: Highlights rs10455872 as a major risk driver for cardiovascular events.

markers.interpretation: The rs3798220 C-allele is associated with smaller apolipoprotein(a) size isoforms, which are cleared slower, leading to elevated Lp(a) levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Variant frequency varies widely by geographic ancestry.

sources.name: LPA Ile4399Met and coronary risk
sources.notes: Identifies the smaller isoform-associated Met4399 variant as a genetic risk marker.

markers.impact: Altered melanocortin-4 receptor expression / satiety regulation
markers.interpretation: MC4R is a master hypothalamic regulator of energy homeostasis. The C allele is associated with minor satiety signaling impairments and higher baseline caloric intake.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common variant with small phenotypic impact compared to rare monogenic MC4R mutations.

sources.name: MC4R variants and obesity risk
sources.notes: Large GWAS detailing common MC4R modifier effects.

markers.interpretation: Common metabolic variants are small-effect modifiers. Diabetes, insulin resistance, obesity, dyslipidemia, gout, and fatty liver require labs, phenotype, medications, diet, body composition, and clinician interpretation.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Metabolic traits are strongly environment- and behavior-responsive and highly polygenic.
